summary: Backend testing of cash_register admin-fallback fix. All 12 pytest tests passed (100%). Admin without branch_id can now open/close/preview cash register via fallback to main branch (is_main) or first active branch. Seller with branch_id still uses own branch (no regression). Superadmin correctly blocked with 403. Branch override respected. Regression endpoints (/sales, /patients, /inventory/products, /quotations, /support-tickets) all 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix implementation in /app/backend/routes/cash_register.py::_get_branch_id_or_400 is clean: uses ObjectId conversion, filters is_active!=False, prefers is_main=True. Good separation of concerns. Applies to /open, /close, /current, /current/preview consistently.

The scenario 'empresa sin sucursales activas -> 400' was not directly tested because current admin's company (69cac742cf7c7911e1282501) has active branches; skipped safely per request instructions to avoid destructive data mutation. Code path is straightforward though (final HTTPException 400 with detail 'La empresa no tiene sucursales activas...').

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is cookie-based (httpOnly). Use requests.Session and login POST /api/auth/login; token may not appear in response body. Existing test test_cash_register_admin_fallback.py can be reused for regression on cash register endpoints.
rca of the issue: Original bug: admins without branch_id received 400 on POST /api/cash-register/open because _get_branch_id_or_400 raised when neither override nor user.branch_id present. Fix adds a branches lookup by company_id preferring is_main=True, falling back to first active branch, only raising 400 if the company has no active branches. Verified end-to-end: admin open->200 with valid branch_id; close->200; current & preview->200; override->200 and respected; seller unchanged.
